Chapter 341: Chapter 6: Unifying the Black Mist Mountain Range, the True King Without a Crown (Subscribe Please)

“If I return now to the Main World, the size of my Inner World would likely exceed a hundred miles, or even several hundred miles…”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

Normally, for someone newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, their Inner World would reach a span of a hundred miles.

Along with continuous practice at the Eighth Rank, the Inner World will slowly grow.

The expansion primarily depends on the understanding of the Space Rules.

It is also about comprehending more of the core space models,

...

leading to a more stable spatial foundation in the Inner World, which would facilitate easier expansion.

If one lacks sufficient understanding of space and forcibly expands the Inner World, it might cause its collapse.

But with Lin Yuan’s current understanding of the Space Rules, expanding his Inner World to several hundred miles would be easy.

An Inner World of several hundred miles, even though Lin Yuan has only just entered the Seventh Rank, would allow him to contend with someone at the newly advanced Eighth Rank with the vast power of his world.

“Seventh Stage Martial Tao…”

Lin Yuan’s expression fell into brief contemplation.

Over these years, he had devoted much of his time to refining and perfecting the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

After all, Lin Yuan was well aware that his foundation was still the Martial Arts Evolution System, though the cultivation system of the Demon Tree was only temporary.

Initial cultivation of entities like the Ancestral Demon Tree, an Foreign Evil God, is swift, but it harbors many dangers.

It is nowhere as steadily progressive and inherently righteous as the Martial Arts Evolution System.

“Now I’ve basically completed the ‘Marquis’ stage of the Seventh Rank Chapter, the next step is the ‘King’ level…”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

The many Evolution Paths in the Main World divide the Seventh Rank into three stages.

Marquis.

King.

Lin Yuan applied the same three stages to his Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

Completing the ‘Marquis’ stage equates to finishing one-third of the Seventh Rank Chapter.

The only stages left are ‘King’ and ‘King’.

…

“It’s about time to make a move…”

Lin Yuan glanced towards the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Since the Phoenix King ‘disappeared,’ the remaining seven ‘Kings’ of the mountain range had gathered together.

This act thwarted Lin Yuan’s plan to defeat them one by one.

For nearly a decade, Lin Yuan’s roots permeated every corner of the Black Mist Mountain Range, except for its deepest part.

He was concerned it might startle the snake.

But now…

With Lin Yuan’s strength, those seven kings could be suppressed with a counterattack.

…

At the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Seven colossal beings stood there.

Their terrifying presence pervaded; ordinary Demonic Beasts, let alone approaching, would tremble in fear just by sensing a fraction of this atmosphere.

These seven colossal beings are the seven ‘Kings’ of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Together with the previous Phoenix King, they are known as the Black Mist Eight Kings, having been the absolute rulers of the mountain range for many long years.

However, at this moment.

The atmosphere among these seven ‘Kings’ was heavy, their expressions and eyes filled with worry.

“Where could the Phoenix King have gone? It has been ten years without a trace.”

The Divine Ape King spoke softly, his massive voice vibrating in all directions.

Upon hearing this.

The rest of the six kings exchanged glances.

They too were curious about the whereabouts of the Phoenix King.

Ten years ago, the Phoenix King suddenly disappeared, taking with it a phoenix tree and Earthflame Valley, resulting in ominous thoughts among them.

That was why.

For the past ten years, the seven Kings have stayed together, never separating, all to guard against something.

But this can’t go on forever.

It’s been ten years since the Phoenix King disappeared, and it likely met with misfortune.

“We can’t just keep waiting.”

“In a moment, I will go out and meet with the Tianqing Alliance Leader to inquire if he is aware of this matter…”

The leading Colossus King finally spoke out.

Among the Eight Kings of the Black Mist, the Colossus King, with the blood of ancient divine elephants flowing within, is the leader.

“Right.”

“Go and ask the Tianqing Alliance Leader.”

“Indeed, even if the leader doesn’t know, he should investigate.”

“I want to see who would dare to strike against the Black Mist Mountain Range.”

The other Demon Beast Kings discussed amongst themselves.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader, being the strongest in the Tianqing World, is a major force against the Foreign Evil Gods.

Given the character of the Tianqing Alliance Leader, he would not allow internal strife in the Tianqing World when there should be unity against external forces.

However, before anything was confirmed, they dared not casually contact the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

If they just reported to the Tianqing Alliance and the Phoenix King returned soon after, it would be awkward.

They might even be held accountable by the leader.

But ten years have passed with no news of the Phoenix King, so it was time to report to the Tianqing Alliance Leader.

“Let’s go.”

“Let’s go together.”

The seven Demon Beast Kings got up, ready to fly outside.

Suddenly.

The Giant Elephant King’s expression subtly shifted.

“There’s something outside.”

The Giant Elephant King’s form froze, his gaze intensely scanning the surroundings.

“Something wrong?”

Hearing this, the other six kings immediately became alert.

The next moment.

Hum.

A black vine descended from the sky.

“Huh?”

The Divine Ape King’s face changed dramatically, his instincts urging him to dodge.

Although unclear what the black vine was, the instinct of a Demon Beast King made the Divine Ape King want to keep away.

However, at that moment, the Divine Ape King’s movements seemed to slow down numerous times.

More precisely, the space around the Divine Ape King appeared to stretch many times over, turning what should have been a stepable distance into one where hundreds of steps still spun in place.

Whoosh.

The black vine quickly engulfed the Divine Ape King and dragged him upwards.

The Giant Elephant King and the other six Demon Beast Kings could clearly see the Divine Ape King still desperately struggling while entwined by the black vine.
